body: Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. RSI-Opt substantially improves optimizer-agent performance, with representative raw-space summary z-scores increasing from +10.48 to +14.33 on the evolution suite with Opus 5.5 and from -0.36 to +3.11 on held-out tasks with GPT-5.5 through cross-model policy transfer. On the Burgers PDE, it reduces mean relative L_2 error by approximately 2.7-fold with Opus 5.5 and 8.8-fold with GPT-6.1 over the fixed-prompt agent baseline, although PDE transfer varies across LLMs and tasks. Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks. These findings demonstrate how procedures and executable tools accumulated across training runs can improve optimizer-agent performance and support transfer to scientific machine learning.
summaryZh: RSI-Opt：用于模型训练的递归自我改进优化器代理。传统的神经网络训练通常遵循预定义的优化方案，激励 LLM 代理监控训练动态并随着训练的进展调整优化器设置，但固定的代理策略不会在运行过程中积累经验。我们介绍 RSI-Opt，一种即插即用的递归自我改进优化器代理，它发展了指导此过程的知识：提示、过程手册、经过测试的优化器代码库和决策节奏。
